newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger president names new government.
newsitem.headline: Niger president names new government.

text.p: Niger's president, Ibrahim Bare Mainassara, has named a new government, cutting the size of his administration from 27 to 24, officials said.
A Friday decree naming the government gave no reason but political analysts said it appeared to be a technical reshuffle, with some ministers taking on extra duties and others switching portfolios.
Madame Bayard Gamatie Mariama was the main new arrival, taking over as communication and culture minister. She was previously an adviser to the president.
The previous ministers of communication, social development, higher education and industrial development and a deputy finance minister all left the government.
Mainassara seized power in a January 1996 military coup, toppling an elected civilian president.
He won a July presidential election but drew cries of foul from the opposition and the United States after scrapping the electoral commission part way through polling and naming one of his own.
